name: Easy Buffalo Chicken Casserole with Carrots & Cheddar-Bread Crumb Topping

ingredients.name: rotisserie chicken, white and dark meat

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap). Add salt, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, uncover, add noodles, and stir for a few seconds; cook until desired firmness, 5-7 minutes. Drain noodles and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tsp salt
283 g egg noodles, wide

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, place chicken on a cutting board and, using your hands, remove meat from the skin and bones; separate the meat into shred-like pieces. Transfer chicken to a large baking dish, then add soup, carrots, hot sauce, and seasoning. Stir to combine and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (532 g) whole chicken rotisserie chicken, white and dark meat
2 (283 g) can condensed cream of celery soup
1 (283 g) bag shredded carrots
½ cup hot sauce
2 tsp herb and garlic seasoning

instructions.primary_message: Place cheddar, bread crumbs, and additional seasoning in a medium bowl. Stir to combine the topping.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 cups cheddar cheese, shredded
1 cup panko bread crumbs
2 tsp herb and garlic seasoning

instructions.primary_message: When the noodles are done, add to the baking dish with the chicken and stir once more to combine. Sprinkle with the cheddar topping.
Place baking dish in the oven and bake until the casserole is warmed through and topping is golden, 35-40 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide casserole between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
